value: The wages have been updated and revised to more accurately reflect the cost burden to the Federal Government.  The number of annual reviews declined from 180 to 79. name: source_line_97
value: Because CTC is the sole DHS source for all TSA-trained canines and handlers, the TSA has partnered with local law enforcement agencies under a reimbursement agreement to train students and canines and pair the canine teams through annual evaluations.  To ensure standardization of all TSA student training, the civilian students attend the same courses as TSA students.  This may include pairing civilian students with an explosives-only canine in the CTC Explosives Detection Canine Handler Course; pairing civilian students with trained canines in the Passenger Screening Canine Handler Course; or enrolling students previously certified by the TSA to attend the Bridge Course to enhance their skillset.  Doing so ensures all students with the TSA’s National Explosives Detection Canine Team Program receive the same course materials to successfully operate in the operational environments associated with TSA (airports, mass transit, and water vessels with the transportation triad).  Lastly, CTC will be developing a course specifically for civilian supervisors and trainers that incorporates much of the content and materials in the Canine Technical Operations Course and Canine Management Course.
scope: Source assertion, potentially several inputs; no inferred scalar value

provenance.original: Because CTC is the sole DHS source for all TSA-trained canines and handlers, the TSA has partnered with local law enforcement agencies under a reimbursement agreement to train students and canines and pair the canine teams through annual evaluations.  To ensure standardization of all TSA student training, the civilian students attend the same courses as TSA students.  This may include pairing civilian students with an explosives-only canine in the CTC Explosives Detection Canine Handler Course; pairing civilian students with trained canines in the Passenger Screening Canine Handler Course; or enrolling students previously certified by the TSA to attend the Bridge Course to enhance their skillset.  Doing so ensures all students with the TSA’s National Explosives Detection Canine Team Program receive the same course materials to successfully operate in the operational environments associated with TSA (airports, mass transit, and water vessels with the transportation triad).
